primary_question.question: Why is my Chicken Sukka too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not walk away because dry spices burn quickly

related_questions.question: Why does my Chicken Sukka stick or tear?
evidence: Do not grind while very hot because the paste can turn sticky

related_questions.question: Why is my Chicken Sukka too dense or dry?
evidence: Do not add too much water or the sukka will take longer to dry

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Chicken Sukka?
evidence: Do not let the oil smoke

related_questions.question: Why does my Chicken Sukka taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not brown the onion too dark or the sukka may taste bitter
